<b>Leaf Rollers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are pointed bugs from [[Verdania]] that pose as plant life.<ref>Leaf Roller Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Pointed scurrier posing as plant life."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Leaf Rollers naturally walk back and forth, turning around once they reach a wall or an edge. Some may be found posing as leaves in the ground, and will unburrow once Hornet comes near.<br>
Once Hornet gets near, Leaf Rollers fly into the air slightly and hover for a brief moment, before darting at Hornet at a low angle, bouncing once and then getting back up.<br>
If one falls off an edge, it flutters to slow its fall before gracefully landing on the ground and continuing its aimless wandering.

Leaf Rollers make no attempt to pursue Hornet.

== Location ==
Leaf Rollers can be found in [[Lost Verdania]].
